articles.title: Jensen Huang and the Cult of the Male Tech Founder
articles.summary: Even by Silicon Valley's standards, Jensen Huang’s scandals were outlandish. Huang resigned two weeks ago following reports that he had an affair with tech executive Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese spy whose company was suspected of steering restricted advanced AI chips to the country. He has also reportedly engaged in at least two other affairs with subordinates at Nvidi a and was known for belittling those who worked under him. articles.title: Mamdani Unveils Plan to Close Infamous Rikers Island, Replace It With ‘Borough-Based Jails’ by 2032. How Would It Work?
articles.summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has announced plans to shut down the city’s Rikers Island jail complex in 2032 after a century in operation, setting an end date for a site that has long been infamous for persistent violence and abuse. In its place, the city is set to open “borough-based” jails in four of its five boroughs : Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, and the Bronx. GTA VI is More Than Just a Violent Crime Thriller. It's an Unexpected Exercise in Love and Empathy
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI is inescapable; everyone is talking about it. Even people and venues you wouldn’t expect are taking notice. I certainly didn’t have The Weather Channel and Anderson Cooper on my bingo card. Workers are taking time off to play and teachers have alternately canceled classes and bribed their students not to play hooky. articles.title: Havana, Caracas and Trump’s Unfinished Business in Latin America
articles.summary: “I want to get Cuba done before I leave you,” President Donald Trump told a conservative radio host on Nov. 12. It is a reminder that, despite the historic beating his party took in the midterm elections, Trump continues to see Latin America as a crucial part of his legacy.
